[SWS_DM_00100] Supported Service subfunction level checks
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04276
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall check, whether there is a configured
internal or external service processor for the incoming diagnostic request. If there
exists a service processor on
SID
level, but not for the subfunction of the request, the
Verification shall be considered as failed and the negative response code shall be 0x12
(
kSubFunctionNotSupported
).
⌋
